name: "🌟 Feature Request"
about: "Suggest a new feature or improvement for BJH OS"
title: "[Feature] Short description of your idea"
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ""

---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you want to see in BJH OS.

## 🎯 Purpose / Benefit
Explain why this feature is useful or important. What problem does it solve or how does it improve the user/developer experience?

## 🔧 Suggested Implementation
(Optional) Share your ideas on how this feature could be implemented. Include mockups, pseudocode, or references if possible.

## ⚡ Alternatives Considered
(Optional) List any alternative solutions or approaches you’ve considered and why you think your suggestion is better.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or links that might help understand your suggestion.
